'''Lianne Marie Dobbs''' is an American actress, voice actress, and vocalist for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
As an adult, Dobbs became an actress and a voice actress, getting only a few minor roles. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}. Her best-known roles in the series are [[Anthea and Concordia|Anthea]], {{an|N}}'s foster sister; and [[Merilyn]], a thief.
